description: This file defines an internal helper class 'AdoGrainKey' used for managing grain key information within an Orleans storage provider context. It includes multiple constructors to initialize the key with long, Guid, or string types, methods to generate hash bytes, and string representations of the key.

classes.name: AdoGrainKey
classes.description: Helper class for managing different types of grain keys including long, Guid, and string, with methods to generate hash byte arrays and string representations.

methods.name: AdoGrainKey (long key, string keyExtension)
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the key with a long value and an extension string.

methods.name: AdoGrainKey (Guid key, string keyExtension)
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the key with a Guid and an extension string; converts the Guid to byte array to set N0Key and N1Key.

methods.name: AdoGrainKey (string key)
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the key with a string key.

methods.name: GetHashBytes
methods.description: Generates a byte array representing the hash of the key, combining key components with the string extension if applicable.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the key, combining primary key and extension separated by '#'.
